contract: Read Annex B configuration with AnnexBConfigParser and compare ordered parameter sets with the side data produced by extract_extradata. Absence of configuration side data is a refusal. AnnexBWriter must emit the four-byte start code before each candidate parameter set. The complete NAL sequences of configuration blobs also run as length-prefixed samples.

For declared avcC and hvcC layouts, verify the retained record through Configuration::declared_record and DeclaredConfigParser. Fold kind 2 with the retained length and bytes, using the padded input record handed to the reference filter. The reference converts the record through MP4-to-Annex-B initialization. The declared layout is fixture data and candidate-only metadata appears in trace.

Fold kind 1 with parameter set or NAL type and the length and bytes, including the header. Remove start codes and inter-unit Annex B zero padding. Preserve terminal bytes. Fold kind 7 with unit count or kind 8 on refusal. Kind 3 preserves output that did not convert to Annex B.
Input loading and reading the caller declarations take place outside the operation. Parser and filter setup, writing, folding and teardown are inside.
